title: Meet somewhere else
setting: Minutes later. Chris reaches the first coffee place and finds a line out the door. Slightly denser reductions; speed holds.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: So, uh. The Third Street place is packed. There's a line out the door.
lines.spoken: So, uh. The Third Street place is packed. There's a line out the door.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: You wanna meet somewhere else? There's that other coffee place, the one with the yellow sign, like a block over.
lines.spoken: You wanna meet somewhere else? There's that other coffee place, the one with the yellow sign, like a block over.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: It's not that loud. Or we could do the bookstore, they have a little cafe in the back.
lines.spoken: It's not that loud. Or we could do the bookstore, they have a little cafe in the back.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Ooh. Yeah. I'm closer to the bookstore, actually.
lines.spoken: Ooh. Yeah. I'm closer to the bookstore, actually.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Okay, let's do that. I'll walk over. Give me like seven minutes.
lines.spoken: Okay, let's do that. I'll walk over. Gimme like seven minutes.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I'll probably get there first. You want me to get in line?
lines.spoken: I'll probably get there first. You want me to get in line?

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Yeah, if there is one. If not, just grab a table and text me.
lines.spoken: Yeah, if there is one. If not, just grab a table and text me.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: What are you gonna want? In case I get to the counter.
lines.spoken: What're you gonna want? In case I get to the counter.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Just a black coffee. I don't even care. I just wanna sit down.
lines.spoken: Just a black coffee. I don't even care. I just wanna sit down.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Same. Okay, bookstore cafe. Don't go back to Third by accident.
lines.spoken: Same. Okay, bookstore cafe. Don't go back to Third by accident.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I won't. I'm turning around now.
lines.spoken: I won't. I'm turning around now.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Good. If it's packed too, I'll text you and we'll just... I don't know, keep walking.
lines.spoken: Good. If it's packed too, I'll text you and we'll just... I dunno, keep walking.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Yeah. One problem at a time, though.
lines.spoken: Yeah. One problem at a time, though.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Fair. See you in a bit.
lines.spoken: Fair. See you in a bit.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: See you. Black coffee. I'm easy.
lines.spoken: See you. Black coffee. I'm easy.

gist.askZh: 第一家店为什么不行了？
gist.askEn: Why isn't the first place going to work?

accept: cafe in the back of the bookstore

details.askZh: Chris 还提过另一个备选吗？
details.askEn: What other place does Chris mention?
accept: the one with the yellow sign
another coffee place a block over
再过去一条街的咖啡店

details.askZh: Chris 想喝什么？Maya 到了要做什么？
details.askEn: What does Chris want, and what should Maya do when she arrives?
accept: get in line or grab a table and text
排队或占桌然后发消息

glue.noteZh: wanna meet somewhere 连成一串，else 才把‘换地方’说完，somewhere 不要听成 some where。
glue.standard: You want to meet somewhere else

glue.span: What are you going to want
glue.noteZh: What are you 缩成 what're you，gonna want 再叠一层，整句问的是他想点什么。
glue.standard: What are you going to want

glue.noteZh: 又是 gimme like + 时间，和上一场的 give me like fifteen 是同一骨架。

chunks.sayAfter: It's packed. You wanna meet somewhere else?
Yeah. I'm closer to the bookstore, actually.

chunks.form: Just grab a table and text me.
chunks.meaningZh: 先占个座，然后给我发消息。
chunks.sayAfter: If there's no line, just grab a table and text me.

roleplay.setupZh: 你们刚定的那家店排到了门外。你要提议换地方，给出一两个具体选项，并说清谁先到、先做什么。
roleplay.aiRole: Maya, a little wet and a little sarcastic, but cooperative. She's closer to the bookstore and will get in line or grab a table. She wants to know what to order.
variants: The bookstore cafe is also busy.
Chris would rather try the yellow-sign place.
They decide to get drinks to go and walk.
mustUse: Just grab a table and text me

fluency.promptZh: 讲讲他们为什么又换地方，备选有哪些，最后为什么选书店，各自到了要做什么。准备 15 秒，然后 60、45、30 秒。
fluency.promptEn: Tell why the first cafe didn't work, what the options were, why they chose the bookstore, and what each person would do on arrival. Prep 15 seconds, then 60, 45, 30.
